exercises.name: Prostowanie przedramienia z hantlem w opadzie

scenes: Seated triceps extension MACHINE, upper arms supported, hands extending lever handles downward.
CLOSE-GRIP barbell bench press, supine flat bench with hands only shoulder width apart and elbows tucked.
Single arm dumbbell triceps kickback, hinged torso, opposite hand on bench, working upper arm next to torso and elbow extended backward.
Seated abdominal crunch MACHINE, athlete curling torso forward under padded resistance, hands near head on handles.
KNEELING cable rope abdominal crunch, athlete kneels facing high pulley, rope beside temples, torso curled forward.
Standing CABLE torso rotation, facing sideways to pulley at chest height with two hands on one handle, arms extended and torso rotating.
